'''Z-18''' was under the rule of the [[Energy Vampire|energy vampire]] [[Rajine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He previously belonged to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Samuro]], and led [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] Samuro had left when Windu was imprisoned by Rajine. Although Z-18 was bisected by Rajine using Windu's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for freeing a prisoner, he was avenged by the Master, who used the holocron to turn Rajine's zombies upon her.
